verdict.summary: SGFIN (59/100) is a Reject / AVOID. Both hard gates pass (Trend Template 8/8, investability clean), and the price/RS profile is genuinely elite: 154% above its 52-week low, only 2.6% below its 52-week high, RS percentile 96, with the 50/150/200 DMA stack correctly aligned. But the stock fails on Minervini's quality and structure axes, not its momentum axes. Earnings growth is decelerating (74.8% -> 85.6% -> 52.1% -> 37.0% YoY), the cash engine is broken (3-year cumulative OCF/PAT of -15.1 and FCF of -1572 crores, negative in all 3 years), leverage and ROE are unverified so the entire balance-sheet and profitability blocks score near zero on missing data rather than verified strength, and the base is 0.2 weeks old with zero contraction or volume dry-up evidence. Under the default REJECT posture, a 59/100 with a POOR_CASH_CONVERSION red flag is not an actionable setup.
strengths: Trend Template is a clean 8/8 pass: price 821.05 above 50/150/200 DMA (672.21/637.88/578.45), DMAs correctly stacked, 200 DMA rising ~4 months
Relative strength is top-decile: RS percentile 96, up/down volume ratio 1.52, 154.2% above 52-week low and only 2.6% below 52-week high
Earnings block is the strongest sub-score (21/25): latest- quarter EPS YoY in the 50-99% bucket, 3-yr EPS CAGR 63.7%, positive EPS in all 8 quarters with zero other-income contribution
Revenue block solid (13/15): latest-quarter sales YoY +104.8%, 3-yr sales CAGR 101.2%, sales-supported EPS growth
Promoter pledge 0%, promoter holding rising over 4 quarters (50.3 -> 56.95)
Liquidity is ample: median daily traded value ~17.4 crore, well above the 5 crore floor
weaknesses: Profitability and quality block is a zero: ROE, ROCE and interest coverage unverified, net margin contracting -69 bps YoY, and cumulative 3-yr OCF/PAT of -15.1 drives the POOR_CASH_CONVERSION red flag
Cash generation is structurally negative: FCF -1572 crore, positive in 0 of 3 years, OCF negative relative to PAT - inconsistent with the reported profit trajectory
Balance sheet block 1/5: D/E unverified (zero points), interest coverage unverified, and share count up 17.9% over 2 years (dilution beyond the 5% cap)
Earnings deceleration is in progress: YoY EPS growth has fallen from 85.6% to 52.1% to 37.0% over the last three quarters
Base structure is unformed: base only 0.2 weeks old, base_count already 2, no contraction sequence, no volume dry-up, no weekly tightness - zero points on G3-G6
Leadership block 0/5 and 9 unverified fields mean the score is penalised by data gaps, not just by measured weakness - a fuller data set could move this materially either way
Sponsorship thin (2/5): MF+FII holding only 3.18% and actually lower than two quarters ago; no marquee institution verified
catalysts: No verifiable NEW catalyst identified with a citable, dateable source - H3 scores 0 and remains unverified
verdict.biggest_risk: POOR_CASH_CONVERSION - a lender/trader generating large notional profits but deeply negative operating and free cash flow is the single most dangerous combination in this scorecard; if it reflects aggressive revenue recognition or a balance-sheet build that stalls, the 96 RS can unwind fast. Secondary risk is that the zero-scored profitability and balance-sheet blocks are unverified, not measured, so the true quality picture is opaque rather than proven-weak.

Gates force the bucket: Trend Template composite fails (c4: 50 DMA below 150 DMA; c8: RS 64 < 70) and the stock is not actionably setting up regardless of a clean balance sheet. Earnings history is strong (A=15, C=10, D=5) but the setup is not there — RS is the binding problem, plus a 29.8% deep, 14.6-week base with a non-contracting 11.8% mid-base leg, only −5.4% volume dry-up, and 2.9% above its 50 DMA yet below a flat-to-falling 50 DMA. No catalyst and no sponsorship confirmation earned points, and Q4 other income at 34.4% of PBT is the flagged OTHER_INCOME_DRIVEN item. This is a good-business-wrong-stage name.

weaknesses: Trend Template fails c4 (50 DMA 2131 < 150 DMA 2150) and c8 (RS 64 < 70)
